Overview

The finders' primary disclosure of EchoLeak (CVE-2025-32711), the zero-click prompt injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot that RPT-0009's worked example (em-01) models. This stub records where it is and how other sources rely on it; its content has not been read. The CVE record's CVE Program (ADP) container lists this URL as a reference. The secondary case study echoleak-zero-click-prompt-injection says "researchers at Aim Security disclosed EchoLeak", cites this disclosure as "Aim Labs 2025", and draws its timeline from it: discovery and a proof of concept in January 2025, disclosure to Microsoft's MSRC, a server-side fix in May 2025, and public disclosure with the CVE on 2025-06-11.
